capabilities: Receive clips from a companion Chrome extension over a loopback HTTP server
Save webpage screenshots as standalone notes with images in a frames subfolder
Merge cover, hook, and keyframe clips from one video into a single note per video
Configure storage folders, port, frame limits, and per-clip-type analysis SOP paths
Return obsidian:// deep links so the extension can open the created or updated note
disambiguation: Only the receiving half of a suite; it does nothing without the Obsidian Visual Clipper Chrome extension installed.
extras: Desktop-only (mobile cannot run the local server). The receiving endpoint is intentionally unauthenticated; the README documents that it binds to loopback only, restricts CORS to chrome-extension origins, and only writes content. Includes troubleshooting and a network-use disclosure.
problem: Browser extensions cannot write files into an Obsidian vault directly, so clipped screenshots and video frames need a bridge that turns them into formatted notes without manual paste-and-format steps.

relations.evidence: Vault Autopilot receives clips from the companion Chrome extension, Obsidian Visual Clipper

summary: Local server plugin that receives screenshots and video clips from a companion Chrome extension and writes structured notes and images into the vault.
